moments.title: Ella Langley hits UK No.1
moments.blurb: Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' has hit Number 1 on the Official UK Singles Chart, marking her breakthrough hit.

angles.name: Chart Triumph
angles.copy: New UK No.1! Huge congrats to Ella Langley as 'Choosin' Texas' takes the top spot on the Official Singles Chart!

angles.name: Artist Spotlight
angles.copy: Country star Ella Langley is officially a UK No.1 artist! Have you heard 'Choosin' Texas' yet? We're playing it loud!

moments.title: Dolly Parton's Posthumous Chart Success
moments.blurb: Following her recent passing at age 80, Dolly Parton has three songs posthumously in the Official UK Singles Chart Top 10, including '9 to 5' at No. 5.

angles.name: Tribute & Chart
angles.copy: A true legend. Following her passing, Dolly Parton has three songs in the UK Top 10, including a new peak for '9 to 5'. A testament to her incredible legacy.

angles.name: Legacy
angles.copy: Dolly Parton's music lives on, with 'Jolene', '9 to 5' and 'Islands in the Stream' all in the UK Top 10. Which is your favourite Dolly classic?
